name: trait-extraction-core
description: Runtime-independent core: metadata indexing, diversity-aware source selection, Level 0/1/2 comparison discovery, visual-impact learning, weighted consensus, candidate/mask generation, confidence scoring, eligibility classification, and evidence/summary generation for generative-NFT trait extraction. No Express/PM2/SSE/server-job-registry/frontend dependency - consumed by both the website backend and the local CLI worker.
